questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Pollination depends on varied visitors and suitable habitats.
options: Pollination depends on varied visitors and suitable habitats.
Counting visits directly reveals every pollination outcome.
Food alone guarantees suitable conditions for all pollinators.

questions.prompt:
